rca_unanticipated: Net foreign selling of approx. Rp 2.58 trillion (Distribution) despite the brief’s expectation of stagnant/sideways flow
Rupiah weakening to USD/IDR 17,957 (above the 17,600 risk threshold) without breaching the flagged level
rca_overestimated: The brief’s emphasis on a potential breach of USD/IDR 17,600 as a primary risk driver (the rate did not breach this level, yet the market still fell)
rca_underestimated: The magnitude of foreign outflows, which turned strongly negative and amplified the sell‑off
The impact of the recent BI rate hike (5.75%) on corporate financing costs, which contributed to broader bearish sentiment
rca_info_delay: Details of the BI rate hike implementation and its immediate market reaction were released after the typical 08:30 briefing cutoff
rca_inverse_correlation: The brief assumed a neutral market outlook would keep IHSG stable, but the combination of unexpected large foreign outflows and heightened rate‑hike concerns caused the index to drop 1.72%.
lessons: Ketika pasar diprediksi netral namun terjadi penjualan asing besar‑besar, maka IHSG turun 1.72% (dari 6010 ke 5896) karena tekanan jual luar negeri.
Ketika risiko rupiah dianggap hanya pada level 17,600 namun rupiah melemah ke 17,957 tanpa brea​k, maka sentimen tetap bearish dan indeks jatuh 1.72%.
summary: Prediksi pasar netral dan aliran asing stagnan tidak terbukti; penjualan asing yang kuat dan pelemahan rupiah menjerumuskan IHSG turun 1.72%.
